title: About the shop
lead: A custom print shop at 840 N State St in Elgin, Illinois.

story.title: Who we are
paragraphs: We print custom shirts, hoodies, hats, banners, business cards and stickers for businesses, teams, events and individuals. We work with customers around Elgin and ship nationwide.
Design help costs nothing. You get a digital proof before anything prints, and most orders are ready 24–48 hours after you approve it.

language.title: We speak your language
language.body: Call, text or write to us in Spanish and we’ll handle your whole order in Spanish.

hours.title: Hours
hours.delivery: Pickup in Elgin, local contactless delivery and nationwide shipping.
